subject.title: [Feature]: Support to edit system prompt template

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class user-editable override contract for core prompt sections such as Safety, Tool Call Style, OpenClaw Control, and Self-Update?
rationale: This changes model-facing safety guidance, prompt precedence, and a core prompt ownership boundary, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract safely.

options.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
options.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, prompt-cache behavior, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep Core Sections Fixed
options.body: Do not add section overrides; document provider overlays, plugin prompt hooks, and bootstrap files as the supported customization paths.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Tracks
options.body: Let identity-line or append-style config-rule work proceed independently while leaving broad Safety/template editing unresolved here.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Section Overrides
recommendation.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, prompt-cache behavior, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest current history on provider-owned prompt contributions and the OpenClaw-owned prompt boundary this decision would change.
